scope: Independent Canon descriptor/misc grammar probe; whole-file framing, sequence resolver and UI tests are separate and pending at this record.
method: The probe used pyavb-confirmed first-object offset119 in these two little-endian AVBs, iterated bounded object chunks, called readAvbDescriptor, and required zero bytes remaining for every handled object. Unknown classes were left to the other reader components.
limits: Successful framing is not a proof of every decoded property meaning.
The probe does not resolve reference graphs or match scanned physical media.
These files do not exercise every descriptor or extension implemented.
No scan-performance or RAM comparison was made.
Source filenames and absolute positions identify these observations; the original probe did not hash the input bins.
